answer: Treat timing as evidence: the ledger tracks when each agent acts and links accounts whose requests keep landing within the same milliseconds. Clones driven by one operator share a thread of correlated behavior, so a flagged cluster splits a single reward instead of collecting many. To evade it, an attacker must let every fake wander on its own schedule with separate infrastructure, like training a separate falcon for each bird, which erases the savings of mass identities.
